author: the author's kitchen

alternatives.note: Loosen it with water a spoon at a time, exactly like tahini: it seizes first and then goes smooth.
alternatives.warning: Greyer than tahini and a little sweeter.

alternatives.note: For richness and body.
alternatives.warning: None of the sesame bitterness, which is usually why tahini is in the recipe.

entries.if_missing: Say the dish will be milder and less bitter. Tahini is a flavour, not only a fat, and nothing here has it.
